QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_MEMORY_BUFFER_ALLOC_C` (`library/memory_buffer_alloc.c`) is itself a client of this mechanism. `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init(buf, len)` carves a static caller-supplied buffer into a free-list heap and calls `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free` on its own functions (`memory_buffer_alloc.c:572-575`).
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the buffer allocator calls the setter from its init function, but it never says it is the only in-tree user, so the "only" claim is missing.
